title: RingCentral to Present at Goldman Sachs and Piper Sandler Conferences
summary: BELMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- RingCentral, Inc. (NYSE: RNG), a global leader in AI-powered customer engagement, today announced that members of its management team are scheduled to present at the following investor conferences: Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference 2026 Date: Thursday, September 10, 2026 Time: 1:45 p.m. PT / 4:45 p.m. ET Piper Sandler Growth Frontiers Conference Date: Tuesday, September 15, 2026 Time: 2:30 p.m. PT / 4:30 p.m. CT A live webcast and replay of these fireside presentations will be accessible on the Company’s investor relations website at ir.ringcentral.com . About RingCentral RingCentral is a global leader in AI–powered customer engagement, delivering an integrated platform for business phone, SMS, contact center, workforce engagement management, video collaboration, and messaging. Powered by advanced AI capabilities, RingCentral delivers intelligence at every phase of the conversation journey — before, during, and after each human interaction. With RingCentral, businesses can work smarter, respond faster, and connect more meaningfully with their customers. Visit ringcentral.com to learn more. © 2026 RingCentral, Inc. All rights reserved. RingCentral and the RingCentral logo are trademarks of RingCentral, Inc. Investor Relations Contact: Steven Horwitz ir@ringcentral.com Media Contact: Mariana Leventis Mariana.Leventis@ringcentral.com Source: RingCentral, Inc.

BELMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


[RingCentral, Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ringcentral.com&esheet=54597733&newsitemid=20260902359206&lan=en-US&anchor=RingCentral%2C+Inc.&index=1&md5=b69365f8fd613794c209f45c14aeed43) (NYSE: RNG), a global leader in AI-powered customer engagement, today announced that members of its management team are scheduled to present at the following investor conferences:


**Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference 2026** Date: Thursday, September 10, 2026
Time: 1:45 p.m. PT / 4:45 p.m. ET


**Piper Sandler Growth Frontiers Conference** Date: Tuesday, September 15, 2026
Time: 2:30 p.m. PT / 4:30 p.m. CT


A live webcast and replay of these fireside presentations will be accessible on the Company’s investor relations website at[ir.ringcentral.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fir.ringcentral.com%2F&esheet=54597733&newsitemid=20260902359206&lan=en-US&anchor=ir.ringcentral.com&index=2&md5=9cd05ffedb60fd9fd8a3ace1c91a32c0) .


**About RingCentral**


RingCentral is a global leader in AI–powered customer engagement, delivering an integrated platform for business phone, SMS, contact center, workforce engagement management, video collaboration, and messaging. With RingCentral, businesses can work smarter, respond faster, and connect more meaningfully with their customers. Visit ringcentral.com to learn more.
